definitions: Left a place, especially to go to a social event or for entertainment.
Stopped burning or shining; became extinguished.
Became unfashionable or no longer popular.
Began a romantic relationship with someone.
Was sent or distributed, as in mail or information.
examples: They went out for dinner last night.
The lights went out during the storm.
That style of music went out years ago.
He went out with her for a few months.
